jobs.occupation: Artificial intelligence for infection-driven cancers
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a double degree PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

The position is part of the MSCA project TagTIC - Target mining for the development of therapeutics against pathogen-induced cancers, ID: 101311627, Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01-01. Project website: tagtic.eu

Note that this is a double degree PhD project within an MSCA Joint Doctorate. Under the currently planned arrangement, the candidate will work for approximately three years at TissueGnostics GmbH in Vienna, Austria, and one year at Aarhus University, Denmark.

Research area and project description:

Microbial infections are increasingly recognized as important contributors to cancer, but identifying the spatial tissue features and molecular signatures associated with infection-driven disease remains challenging. Integrating tissue imaging with spatial transcriptomics and microbiome information offers opportunities to characterize disease-associated patterns and improve biomarker discovery.

Consortium: This PhD postion is part of the interdisciplinary TagTIC consortium, which brings together expertise in microbiology, virology, oncology, immunology, medicinal chemistry, imaging, AI, and bioinformatics, with support from associated partners in biotech, diagnostics, and science communication. Its collaborative structure allows doctoral candidates to work within a network where discovery science, technology development, training, and societal impact are closely connected.

Project DC11: This PhD is part of the TagTIC consortium. It combines machine learning with image analysis to support precision oncology. The aim is to develop AI algorithms that integrate tissue imaging, spatial transcriptomics and microbiome data (multiomics) to identify biomarkers and predict disease progression.

Project description: For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Salary, holiday payment, pension contributions and the like include all employer and employee's taxes and contributions. Thus, figures are before taxes are paid, and taxes may differ depending on individual circumstances. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with applicable collective agreement and national rules of the employing institution. The allowances mentioned in the EU work programme (living allowance, mobility allowance and, if applicable, family allowance) will be part of the salary in accordance with MSCA rules.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must have a relevant master's degree in biology, biotechnology, molecular medicine, biomedicine, microbiology, cancer biology, bioengineering, bioinformatics or a closely related field.

General Criteria:

• MSCA Mobility Rule: researchers must comply with the mobility rule applicable to the country of the recruiting beneficiary.

• All researchers recruited in a DN must be doctoral candidates (i.e. not already in possession of a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment).

• Applicants must fulfil the admission requirements of the participating degree-awarding universities for the TagTIC Joint Doctorate.

• Scientific excellence and a strong fit with the PhD project

• Fluent (oral and written) English skills as the project operates in English

• Scientific curiosity, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Team-mindedness and willingness to work in an interdisciplinary and international environment

Required skills:

• Proficiency in artificial intelligence/machine-learning concepts, relevant frameworks, and Python programming

• Experience with Julia, R, or C++, together with knowledge of statistics, is an advantage

• An excellent academic background and strong interdisciplinary interest in artificial intelligence, cancer, infection biology, and drug discovery research

Place of employment and place of work:

Note that this is a double degree PhD project.

Under the currently planned arrangement, the candidate will work at TissueGnostics GmbH, Austria, for three years and at Aarhus University (AU), Denmark, for one year, including at least 12 months at AU for the double-degree arrangement. The detailed employment, doctoral enrolment, and mobility schedule will be confirmed in the applicable agreements and approved TagTIC training plan.

The place of work at Aarhus University is Gustav Wieds Vej 10C, Building 3133, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark. The place of work at TissueGnostics GmbH is Taborstraße 10/2/8, 1020 Vienna, Austria.

EU eligibility requirements in Marie Curie Doctoral Networks:

• Supported researchers must be doctoral candidates, i.e. not already in possession of a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet formally been awarded the doctoral degree will not be considered eligible.

• Researchers supported must be enrolled in a doctoral programme leading to the award of a doctoral degree in at least one EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country, and for Joint Doctorates in at least two.

• Recruited researchers can be of any nationality and must comply with the following mobility rule: they must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting beneficiary for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before their recruitment date.

• Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays and time spent by the researcher as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.

• Secondments are eligible for up to one third of the actual months spent implementing the research training activities under the action.

• For Joint Doctorates, doctoral candidates must be enrolled in programmes leading to a joint, double or multiple doctoral degree involving at least two degree-awarding institutions.

Contacts:

Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• Cindrilla Chumduri, cindrilla.chumduri@bce.au.dk (main supervisor)

• Rupert Ecker, Rupert.ecker@tissuegnostics.com (co-supervisor; CEO, TissueGnostics GmbH)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply:

Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 25 November 2026 at 23:59 CET

Preferred starting date is 01 January 2027.

Please note:

• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply, regardless of their personal background. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with applicable collective agreement.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.description:
**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Business Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering impactful digital transformation projects for our clients. Leveraging your NetSuite expertise, you will lead complex implementations, oversee advanced configurations, and act as a trusted advisor. You will also mentor junior consultants and progressively develop your people management skills, with the opportunity to lead your own team in the future.

• Lead and execute end-to-end NetSuite implementation projects, from requirements gathering to go-live and post-implementation support.

• Oversee advanced NetSuite configurations and customizations to meet customer needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Configure, customize, and optimize NetSuite modules according to client needs.

• Monitor, test, validate, and resolve advanced problems in NetSuite areas.

• Maintain and document high-level processes and complex customizations for external stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing best practices and recommendations.

• Support change management and user adoption initiatives.

• Manage overall relationships as Customer Success Manager for medium to large customers, handling tickets, organizing calls, and ensuring quality.

• Contribute to project planning, scoping, and estimation activities, collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure project success.

• Participate in sales and presales activities as an expert.

• Mentor and supervise business and tech analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and supporting their development through activities such as regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career growth planning, while ensuring high standards in methodology and consulting practices.

• Act as the right hand of the Manager or Director, upholding company values and amplifying leadership messages.

• Contribute to internal projects fostering innovation and growth through entrepreneurial ideas and OKRs.

• Stay updated on NetSuite developments and actively share knowledge with the team.

Why joining Novutech?

• Be part of a fast-growing company with a startup spirit, and enjoy a friendly environment with tremendous colleagues and a hybrid work setup.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Enjoy international exposure by collaborating closely with colleagues across our global offices, enriching your professional experience and broadening your cultural understanding.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in NetSuite consulting, implementation, or administration.

• Proven track record of successful NetSuite implementations and advanced configuration.

• Strong understanding of business processes (Finance, Accounting, Operations, etc.).

• Experience working in a consulting environment or with multiple clients.

• Demonstrated experience in mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.

• Customer Success Management experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong client relationships.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, Life Cycle Management
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**About The Role

**Genmab is seeking a Project Manager CMC Product Lifecycle Management to

• join the CMC Life Cycle Management (LCM) Team and support our growing portfolio of commercial products globally.

The LCM team is responsible for managing the CMC lifecycle activities of Genmab’s commercial products and manufacturing oversight, ensuring supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and successful execution of post-approval activities throughout the product lifecycle. In this role, you’ll work closely with LCM Product Lead and colleagues across Commercial Supply Chain, MSAT, Regulatory CMC, Commercial QA and External Manufacturing to ensure seamless execution of lifecycle management activities.

The CMC Life Cycle Management Team is part of CMC Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) which also includes the Early-Stage Development, Late-stage Development and External Manufacturing teams. CMC Project & Portfolio Management resides within CMC Development and Manufacturing, based in Denmark.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Genmab's commercial portfolio while working in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment at the interface of development, manufacturing, supply, and regulatory affairs.

**Responsibilities

**

• Work alongside the LCM Lead to provide manufacturing oversight and execute lifecycle activities for an assigned manufacturing track (DS, BI, CI or DP) after commercial launch, supporting batch release and reliable supply. The LCM Lead retains overall product accountability.

• Lead operational governance with internal functions and partners/CMOs, aligning priorities, preparing decisions, tracking progress and actions, and providing input on CMO performance.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on daily operations to ensure manufacturing oversight (ie. Deviation management, change control, complaint handling, etc) , support batch release and supply, issues resolution/escalation and quality/regulatory compliance.

• Coordinate technical issue resolution and manage track risks with relevant experts, ensuring required assessments, documentation and mitigation actions, and escalating issues with proposed next steps.

• Drive manufacturing changes, projects and improvements within agreed scope, timelines and budgets.

• Support implementation of CMC commitments and Post-approval change management related to assigned product manufacturing track (i.e DS, BI, CI, DP) and support coordination of submission documentation preparation across stakeholders and CMOs/Partners.

• Support initiatives to optimize yield, reduce cost of goods, and enhance robustness of manufacturing and testing processes

• Help establish and improve LCM processes, governance, tools and ways of working, incorporating lessons learned.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree in science or related technical discipline (e.g. engineering, biotech, pharmaceutical, biochemistry, biology) or equivalent experience;

• 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry, preferably within manufacturing operations, lifecycle, product management for commercial products.

• Experience in building relations and influencing multi-functional teams within multicultural organizations.

• Proven track record in CMC project management, manufacturing operations management or product management across development and commercialization activities.

• Experience managing and defining project coordination activities and tasks in a structured, regulated environment.

• Prior experience with commercial product lifecycle management and oversight of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is considered an advantage.

• Broad understanding of global cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations across major markets

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver against project timelines

• Team player with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

• Result- and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant

• Permanent contract

• Full-time

• At least 5 years of experience (Senior level)

• Bachelor degree

• IT

Mission

**Do you want to help shape the future of supply chain operations at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and a deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, from Sales and Procurement to Warehouse and Logistics? Are you ready to take the lead in shaping and optimizing our global supply chain processes, turning business requirements into effective D365 F&O solutions?

If you are a business-oriented D365 F&O specialist who enjoys engaging with stakeholders, asking the right questions and constructively challenging existing ways of working, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkWith reference to our Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business stakeholders and IT colleagues across our international organization.

As a Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant, your primary focus will be the full Supply Chain area in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, covering order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics. You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to testing, training, go-live and post-production support.

Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant with a focus on Supply Chain ManagementYou will play a key role in shaping and implementing our global D365 F&O solution. Working closely with business stakeholders, developers and ERP specialists, you will translate business requirements into functional designs and sustainable system solutions, while sharing best practices and driving process improvements.

You will also be involved in our transition from Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 to D365 F&O, giving you the opportunity to influence solution design and shape future global processes across Sales, Procurement, Warehouse and Logistics. Through workshops and stakeholder collaboration, you will help deliver harmonized solutions that support our future growth and operational efficiency.

**

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:**

• Lead the configuration and implementation of core D365 F&O Supply Chain modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Configure and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics.

• Advise on supply chain process improvements, with a focus on standard D365 functionality, inventory optimization and process harmonization.

• Gather, analyse and document business requirements, translating them into functional designs, user stories, acceptance criteria and system configurations.

• Develop functional design documentation for customizations, integrations, reports and system enhancements.

• Plan and execute testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and data validation.

• Collaborate with developers, architects and ERP specialists on integrations, customizations, data migration from AX 2012 and issue resolution.

• Lead workshops and training sessions, support implementation and user adoption, and share D365 F&O best practices to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Profile

**Qualifications & requirements

**You bring extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, supported by several years of hands-on implementation experience. You have a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes across Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Logistics. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all levels, constructively challenging requirements and translating business needs into clear, functional solutions.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of experience as a functional consultant implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (D365 F&O).

• Extensive functional knowledge of core D365 F&O modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Proven experience with end-to-end order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes, as well as inbound, outbound, warehousing and inventory processes.

• Experience with advanced Supply Chain modules such as Master Planning, Production Control, or Quality Management.

• Experience with requirements gathering, process mapping, functional design, configuration, testing and implementation.

• Experience with customizations, integrations, data entities, workflows, security roles and data migration.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience leading workshops and collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

**

It is an advantage if you have:**

• Experience in distribution, logistics, manufacturing or other asset-driven industries.

• Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate certification.

• Experience with the Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate and Power Apps.

• Experience with EDI, system integrations or warehouse automation solutions.

• A relevant bachelor's degree, e.g. in Supply Chain Management, Business or IT.

**

Personality matters

**You are curious, analytical and collaborative, with a natural ability to engage with people and build strong relationships across the business and IT. You enjoy asking the right questions, challenging existing processes and finding practical solutions to complex business needs. You communicate clearly, take ownership and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

**

We offer more than just a job

**We wish to be the best at what we do, and everything we do is based on our values of “Winning Attitude, Customer Orientation, and Getting it Done”. We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

**

Ready to apply?

**Please send us your application and CV via the “Apply” button no later than 16. November 2026. We want to fill the position as soon as possible and will continuously invite candidates for interviews, so do not hesitate to submit your application and CV.

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, at kifa@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2097 3050

**

At Wrist, we are committed to cultivating a culture of belonging where every individual feels seen, valued, and respected

**As a global company, we aim to reflect the communities we are part of, believing that our strength comes from diverse perspectives, experiences, and the unique contributions each person offers. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and we are dedicated to maintaining a recruitment process that is inclusive, fair, and respectful. By fostering a supportive workplace culture rooted in belonging, we lay the foundation for meaningful collaboration and shared success.

**

About Wrist

**Wrist is the world’s leading ship and offshore supplier of marine provisions and stores with a market share of approximately 12%. We are the only provisions and stores marine supplier with a global network of supply operations. We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. With the launch of the digital marketplace, Source2Sea, Wrist is leading the digital transformation of the marine supply industry. All year round, we offer 24/7 global online sourcing and logistics, providing data transparency, automation, and convenience to our customers. We continuously work on reducing our climate impact while at the same time proactively addressing our customers’ growing demand and need for responsible solutions and services. From more than 30 locations worldwide, in all major shipping locations, 1,800 Wrist employees take pride in making it easy for our customers to order and receive marine supplies and services.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you know Danish accounting inside out, and want to use that knowledge somewhere things move fast? At Spirii, we build the charging solutions behind the shift to electric driving. As we grow, so does the need for strong, reliable numbers. That is where you come in.

Your role

As Senior Accountant, you will work alongside our other Senior Accountant and closely with the Head of Accounting. Together, you make sure our Danish accounting records are accurate and complete, and that our month-end and year-end close is delivered on time and under control.

This role is for an experienced accountant who wants to go beyond transactional work. You will own complex accounting topics, be the go-to person for accounting questions in the team, and help shape how our finance processes work as we scale as part of the Edenred Group.

What you will do

• 
Own complex general ledger work, including journal entries, accruals, provisions and prepayments

• 
Run monthly balance sheet reconciliations and make sure open items are investigated and cleared

• 
Take ownership of key parts of the month-end and year-end close, including cut-off, closing files and group deadlines

• 
Prepare and review Danish VAT reporting, including complex domestic and cross-border transactions, and file reports with the Danish tax authorities and other agencies

• 
Support statutory reporting and the annual accounts, and work with external auditors and tax advisers

• 
Manage intercompany reconciliations and support group consolidation and reporting

• 
Maintain and improve accounting controls, and help build standard procedures for the team

• 
Take part in ERP, automation and finance improvement projects as we grow

What you bring

• 
5+ years of accounting experience, including experience from a Danish company

• 
Strong knowledge of Danish accounting rules and VAT

• 
Hands-on experience with month-end and year-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, statutory accounts and external audit

• 
Experience with intercompany accounting

• 
Strong Excel skills

• 
Professional fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Nice to have

• 
Experience from an international group, including group reporting or consolidation

• 
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or another modern ERP

• 
Experience improving or automating finance processes

• 
Knowledge of Danish payroll accounting, tax or other local compliance areas

• 
A degree or qualification in accounting, finance or business administration

Who you are

You are technically strong and enjoy solving accounting issues on your own. When you find a difference, you want to understand the root cause, not only fix it. You are precise with details, you own your deadlines, and you know how to balance accounting quality with what the business needs. You like working with colleagues in Denmark and abroad, and you look for ways to improve processes rather than simply follow them.

You will be a trusted partner to the Head of Accounting and a reliable point of reference for the wider team.

Benefits

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects

About Spirii

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, offering hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and public sector. Spirii recently celebrated its seven-year anniversary as a founded company — though the people at Spirii bring far more extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, and with the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Development Manager for Core Banking
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead a team that builds the backbone of Danish banking, and help reinvent how it is built?

In Core Banking, we develop and run the business-critical systems that our member banks rely on every single day. We are now in the middle of a major transformation. We are modernising decades of proven Mainframe technology, opening it up through APIs and event-driven integrations, and embedding AI in the way we develop software.

We are looking for a technically strong Development Manager who wants to be at the centre of this journey. You will lead a skilled team across Denmark and Poland, work closely with the business and our customers, and own the strategic technology roadmap for your area, in BEC and in the future Nykredit Financial Technologies.

The position is based at our office in Roskilde, and you will report to Head of Core Banking.

What you will be part of:

• AI in practice: You won't just be talking about AI. Your team will use AI-assisted development in its daily work across Mainframe/COBOL, Java, APIs and Kafka.

• Your own roadmap: You will build and own the strategic technology roadmap for your area, setting the direction for how your systems evolve.

• Shaping the future: You will help design future solutions together with the business and our customers.

• Real impact: Your work directly affects how banks serve their customers across Denmark.

• Influence: You will be a key voice in the transformation, not just a manager of the backlog.

Your primary tasks and responsibilities include:

Delivery

• Build and maintain the strategic technology roadmap for your area, aligned with Core Banking's overall direction and architecture.

• Lead the delivery of the team backlog, balancing transformation initiatives with day-to-day operations.

• Set clear goals, remove impediments and ensure transparency on progress, decisions and dependencies.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead is a key role within Genmab’s Transformation Office (TO). The Senior Director will be the central orchestrator for operational and strategic initiatives, including initiative intake, prioritization, governance, reporting, and portfolio performance management. You will ensure that Genmab's most strategic initiatives are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value. The initial focus of the Transformation Office is on R&D and Tech Ops (approximately 2,000 FTE), with potential for future scope expansion across the enterprise (⁓3,000 FTE).

The Transformation Office Portfolio Lead partners closely with senior business leaders, initiative sponsors, project managers, finance business partners and functional teams to drive rigorous initiative portfolio management, accelerate execution, and provide transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

As a key driver of the Transformation Office, the Senior Director will lead initiative portfolio management processes, develop recommendations on initiative prioritization, sequencing, and TO resource allocation, and ensure decisions are translated into action to maximize organizational impact.

The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead will report directly to Head of the Transformation Office (currently the SVP, Global Head of PPM & R&D Operations). The position can be located in Plainsboro, NJ, Utrecht, NL or Copenhagen, DK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own portfolio management for cross-functional transformation initiatives that support Genmab’s financial commitments and strategic objectives

• Support the Transformation Office’s goals and objectives, aligned with the company’s overarching strategy and 2030 Vision

• Lead initiative intake screening, categorization, and prioritization processes, ensuring consistent application of prioritization criteria and governance framework

• Support, challenges and monitors projects, initiatives, and analyses focused on company transformation and productivity gains to inform strategic capital allocation and resourcing decisions

• Collaborate closely with Finance on Genmab’s long-range financial plan and annual budget cycle

• Drive the organization’s ongoing mindset shift toward productivity and prioritization

• Drive execution of initiatives from initiation through closure, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, and follow-through

• Track, report, and communicate TO initiatives to major stakeholders at all governance levels, including progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization

• Define, establish, and continuously monitor Transformation Office portfolio KPIs and success measures, ensuring transparent reporting of initiative performance, value realization, and overall portfolio health

• Lead the coordination and preparation of TO meetings and serve as meeting moderator

• Report on industry trends and peer company developments, translate their impact on Genmab, and improve overall strategic decision-making quality

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Tech Ops, Commercialization, Finance, Human Resources, DD&AI, and other teams to drive alignment and execution

**Qualifications

****Qualifications and Requirements

**

• A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business administration, economics or finance required is required; advanced degree (Master's, PhD) preferred.

• Prior management consulting with direct biotech/pharma case experience advising clients on company transformations required

• Prior biotech/pharma operating experience in a Transformation Office capacity and/or program and project management with a Finance background also highly valued

**Requirements

**

• Passionate about life sciences and Genmab’s purpose and mission

• Demonstrated knowledge and expertise to drive company transformations and productivity initiatives

• Experience preparing executive-level materials and presenting recommendations to senior leadership and governance bodies

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills across the different levels within the organization

• Highly organized, attentive to detail, and results-driven, with a strong affinity for financial analysis, business performance metrics, and value realization

• Highly self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership, drive activities independently, and manage multiple priorities

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, drive alignment, and achieve outcomes across cross-functional teams without direct authority

• Structured problem-solving skills

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK962.880,00---1.444.320,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Immunology and Fibrosis
jobs.description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Postdoc in the field of Immunology and Fibrosis as per 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 2 years.

The Department of Biomedicine prioritises diversity and a good work environment, as this is a prerequisite for groundbreaking research. In a diverse and international research environment, dedicated employees are looking to generate new knowledge within biomedical research areas such as infection and inflammation, membranes, neuroscience and personalised medicine. The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. Academic staff contribute to the teaching. English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars. The department employs approx. 500 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory-, core- and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

About the research project
The postdoctoral position is part of a translational research project investigating the interplay between immune cells and fibroblasts in the development and progression of skin fibrosis, with a particular focus on systemic sclerosis (scleroderma) and keloid scarring.

The project is based on the hypothesis that immune checkpoint receptor pathways play a central role in regulating interactions between T helper cells and fibroblasts, thereby contributing to the development and progression of skin fibrosis. By combining advanced cellular and molecular techniques with patient-derived samples, in vitro co-culture systems, 3D ex vivo skin models, and experimental animal models, we aim to identify novel mechanisms driving fibrosis and explore potential therapeutic strategies.

The successful candidate will contribute to several aspects of the project, with a particular emphasis on experimental laboratory work and the integration of molecular and cellular data.

The succesful candidate will join an active and collaborative research team, with one PhD student and two Master's students already involved in the project, offering opportunities for close scientific collaboration, supervision of students, and contributing to the development of a growing research environment focused on inflammation and fibrosis.

Your job responsibilities
As Postdoc in Immunology and Fibrosis your position is primarily research-based but may also involve teaching assignments. You will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with colleagues on your project, where you will receive supervision and guidance.

Your main tasks will consist of:

• Independent research of high international quality, including publication. .
• Analyzing and integrating multi-omics datasets, including single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, to identify cellular interactions and signaling pathways associated with fibrosis.
• Performing advanced cellular and molecular analyses, including multicolor flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and gene expression profiling.
• Establishing and optimizing primary cell cultures and in vitro co-culture systems to investigate interactions between T cells and fibroblasts.
• Developing and applying 3D ex vivo skin models using patient-derived biopsies to investigate fibrotic mechanisms and evaluate potential therapeutic interventions.
• Contributing to experimental studies using mouse models of skin fibrosis, including bleomycin-induced fibrosis and keloid models.
You will report to the Associate Professor Stinne Greisen.

Your competences 
You have academic qualifications at PhD level, within immunology, autoimmunity, molecular medicine, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related field. We highly value experience within:

• Analysis and interpretation of high-dimensional datasets, particularly single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, or other multi-omics approaches.
• Experimental immunology, particularly T-cell biology, immune regulation, or inflammatory signaling pathways.
• Advanced cell culture techniques, including primary human cell cultures, immune cell isolation, and functional co-culture assays.
• Cellular and molecular techniques, including multicolor flow cytometry, immunofluorescence microscopy, and gene and protein expression analyses.
• Development or application of advanced experimental models, including 3D cell cultures, organoids, or ex vivo tissue models.
• Working with animal/mouse models of inflammation or fibrosis
As a person, you have good interpersonal skills, are inclusive and team-oriented and able to contribute to a good work environment. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Postdoc position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Stinne Greisen tel.: (+45) 22451114.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Wilhelm Meyers Alle 4, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews around week 50

Terms of employment 
• Appointment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.
• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
• The yearly base salary for a fulltime postdoc is between DKK 493.394,35 and DKK 585.322,48 depending on the years of working experience after achieved MSc degree. The base salary includes a position related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplemement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.
• Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.
• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff

Application
Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Diploma
• Template for applicant - postdoc
• A list of publications
• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
• A maximum of five of the publications of greatest relevance to the job may be submitted (optional)
• Research plan can be uploaded (optional)
• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)
We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here. Aarhus University also has a Junior Researcher Association and offers career development support. You can read more about these resources here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
Monthio is looking for a Head of Finance with a strong financial foundation and an interest in working closely with the business. You will have overall responsibility for the finance function and a central role in the company's development. Perhaps you already lead a finance function, or perhaps you are an experienced Senior Controller or Finance Business Partner ready to take the next step. Most importantly, you can combine a broad overview with a hands-on approach and thrive with esponsibility for both day-to-day operations and the further development of the finance function. Experience from a similar role is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your role

You will have overall responsibility for financial management, reporting and the ongoing development of Monthio's finance function. You will join the management team, report to the COO and work closely with the CCO and the rest of the management team to provide a true and fair picture of the company's finances and a solid basis for decisions. You will attend board meetings, where you present financial results, expectations and key risks, and you will manage the dialogue with our lender and other external stakeholders.

As the only in-house member of the finance function, you will have a broad role that requires an eye for the whole business and the ability to turn insight into action. Day-to-day bookkeeping and payroll are handled by an external partner. You will manage the partnership, ensure quality and follow up on deliverables. At the same time, you will work hands-on with analyses, models, reporting and processes, and ensure that the finance function supports both daily operations and the company's growth.

Your responsibilities

Budgets, forecasts and liquidity

Drive the budget process and rolling forecasts, and further develop the financial model so that changes in hiring plans, other costs and expected revenue are continuously reflected and provide a basis for adjusting the company's priorities.

Monitor liquidity, cash burn and runway, and make the impact of changes in revenue, costs and investments visible.

Explain variances against budget and forecast, and turn analyses and scenarios into concrete recommendations to management.

Reporting and commercial partnering

Prepare monthly reporting for management and the board, as well as investor reporting, with clear conclusions on performance, expectations and risks.

Prepare board materials together with the COO and the Chairman, and present the key financial points at board meetings.

Consolidate the commercial forecast together with the CCO and ensure consistency between pipeline and forecast.

Accounting and financial control

Ensure a timely and accurate month-end close, including reconciliations, accruals and quality assurance of the accounts, in collaboration with the external partner.

Coordinate the annual report and audit, and ensure follow-up on VAT, tax and other financial filings together with external advisors.

Maintain internal controls and approval procedures, handle payments and ensure correct calculation of sales commissions.

Systems and automation

Drive improvements in finance systems and workflows based on e- conomic, Pleo, Fenerum and Corpay.

Reduce manual work and strengthen data quality through better integrations, automation and relevant use of AI.

Your profile

You master the financial craft, understand the business behind the numbers and take ownership of getting things done. You can challenge assumptions constructively and communicate your conclusions clearly. We value the quality of what you have delivered and your ability to take on broader responsibility.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a relevant degree in finance or business, e.g. cand.merc., cand.merc.aud., HD(R) or equivalent.

• Have solid hands-on experience with financial management and reporting, and an understanding of accounting, budgeting, forecasting and liquidity.

• Have strong analytical skills and can turn complex data into clear insights and concrete recommendations.

• Work independently and in a structured way, and can prioritise between recurring deliverables and developing the finance function.

• Communicate confidently in Danish and English and work well with both colleagues and external partners.

Experience with financial management in a company with large enterprise customers is an advantage, especially if you have worked with ARR, accruals and revenue recognition for large customer contracts. The same applies to experience with board reporting and managing external finance partners. You do not need to have worked with every part of the role beforehand, but you must have the professional foundation and the ability to take overall responsibility and grow in the position.

Perks and benefits

Comprehensive benefits

We offer a pension plan and health insurance so you’re covered from day 1.

Lunch arrangement

With our catered lunches you can choose from a selection of delicious and nourishingoptions.

Flexible working

With our flexible or hybrid working options, you can create a schedule that suits your needs.

Snacks & drinks on tap

Choice of hardware

At Monthio, you have the possibility to choose the hardware that best suits your needs and preferences.

Social activities

Whether it's sports, dining out, board games, or even starting your own group, you'll have the opportunity to bond with your colleagues and share your favourite hobby.

Multimedia package

Enjoy a flexible multimedia package that includes a phone, allowing you to choose what works best for you.

Convenient & green location

Located next to one of Copenhagen’s nicest parks, Monthio is easy to access from public transport, and perfectly situated for walking meetings.

How Monthio hires

Let's connect! We'll chat about your experience and aspirations

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Senior Postdoc of SNSPDs
jobs.description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) is expanding its talented and international team to add to its cutting-edge quantum programme in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, we are running an international quantum computing programme, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, that drives research and innovations at multiple levels - from developing scalable quantum processor technologies to quantum algorithms and applications.  The long-term mission of the programme is to develop fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware and quantum algorithms that solve life-science-relevant chemical and biological problems.

  Start date is the 1st of February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The project 
 The position is centred on the development of integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) embedded in controllable photonic circuits for the fully integrated processing of the emitted photons from silicon quantum emitters. The work will be performed as part of the Photonic Control and Readout team in NQCP, in close collaboration with the Theory & Simulation and the Materials engineering teams at NQCP and the Growth team at Quantum Foundry. These teams will support the efforts of the development and integration of SNSPDs in our photonic circuit.

  You will be collaborating closely with the other team members of the Photonic C&R team and – like the rest of the team - be generally involved in the projects related to the platform. A number of students will also be dedicated to the SNSPD projects. The nanofabrication is done at the DTU Nanolab – a 1,350 m² ISO 4–6 cleanroom with over 150 state-of-the-art tools, and one of the leading cleanrooms in Europe. Testing and integration of the SNSPDs will be done at the NQCP Photonics lab at the Niels Bohr Institute established in 2023. The lab contains a range of cryostats (mK to 4K) designed for optical fibre access, state-of-the-art electronics, commercial SNSPDs, etc.

  The position is also open as an assistant professor. Please apply to the call corresponding to the position relevant for you.

  Responsibilities:

   	
• Taking the leading role in developing and integrating SNSPDs into our photonic circuits and establishing the electrical control circuit. 	
• Structuring the efforts on multiple projects, integrating experimental results in our database, and providing feedback to collaborating teams. 	
• Contributing to the other projects within the Photonics team. The projects span single photon sources and optical components like switches, cavities, etc. 	
• Teaching and supervision of students. 	
• Procurement, maintenance, and operation of scientific equipment.    

  We are looking for the following qualifications: 

   	
• PhD with postdoc experience in experimental physics, engineering, nanotechnologies, or related. 	
• Experience with SNSPDs fabrication and characterisation, quantum photonics, electronics, and cryogenic systems. 	
• Experience with control software and data logging – preferably in python.   Good communication skills and a structured approach to work.
 
 Why Us? 
 Joining NQCP now, you will get involved in a well-established and ambitious programme, which offers excellent opportunities to build a career in advancing quantum computing. We want to make Denmark a world leader in quantum research, and we hope to attract people from all over the world.  

   

  Life in Denmark is supported with strong social services (free universal healthcare, free/subsidised language courses, paid parental leave, subsidised day care institutions and excellent public schools). Our work culture is very egalitarian and prioritises work life balance. Dual career families are the norm, and workplaces offer flexibility to support everyone in having both an exciting career and good family time. Danish cities are known for having excellent infrastructure, for example through widespread bike path networks. We can also offer a thriving food-scene, excellent museums, and beautiful natural scenery. 

   

  Further information on the Department is linked at Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme – University of Copenhagen, Inquiries about the position can be made to Stefano Paesani: stefano.paesani@nbi.ku.dk or Peter Granum: peter.granum@nbi.ku.dk.

   

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  Appointment will be subject to receipt of a security clearance.
 
 The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.
 
 The position is limited in time to 2 years from the date of employment with possible extension. The duration can be negotiated.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background
  

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

   

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  
 Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically.

  Please include

• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position      	
• Original PhD diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish.

  We will call for interviews shortly after the application deadline. Interviews are expected to take place in mid-December or early-January.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Your impact begins here

As Project Manager in Production Support Aseptic Manufacturing, you will take ownership of a portfolio of production projects in Hillerød that needs more hands. You will drive IT, equipment and validation projects from start to finish, helping new products reach production, processes run better and compliance stay strong.

This is a 12-month parental leave cover, with real responsibility from the start. Your work helps the site supply people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

As a Project Manager in our Production Support Aseptic Manufacturing department, you will independently drive projects throughout their entire lifecycle within a production environment that is scaling rapidly to meet growing global demand. The portfolio is expanding, the challenges are complex, and the impact is real.

• A master’s degree in engineering, pharmaceutical sciences or another relevant field.

• Around 4–5 years of professional experience.

• Evidence of strong stakeholder management, communication, leadership and governance.

• Structure and ownership: you plan carefully, work to defined processes and timelines, and follow through on what you commit to.

• The ability to use PowerPoint and Excel to present project timelines, build scenarios and support stakeholder decisions.

• Professional proficiency in English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience as a Project Manager or in a similar coordinating role.

• Experience from a GMP-regulated environment, including aseptic or finished production.

• Experience with IT-related projects.

What you’ll do

You will keep a busy production project portfolio moving, so the people who run the site can focus on supplying treatments.

• Drive projects independently through their full lifecycle, from initiation to completion, in an aseptic and finished production environment.

• Plan, run and follow up on scope, schedule, resources, cost, quality and risk.

• Lead projects across IT, equipment and validation, driven by new product introductions, optimisation and compliance requirements.

• Present timelines and scenarios clearly, so stakeholders can make timely decisions.

• Stay in close dialogue with line of business, site management at all levels and external vendors to keep everyone aligned.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Project Management Office (PMO) in Production Support Aseptic Manufacturing, part of Drug Product Manufacturing within Global Manufacturing & Supply. The PMO is a team of more than 40 Project Managers running small to large projects across the Hillerød site. These cover aseptic production (formulation, filling and inspection), finished production (assembly and packaging), IT, material handling systems and building facilities.

You will work every day with line of business, site management and external vendors. Global Manufacturing & Supply spans the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products, and your projects are part of how the site scales to reach more people. You will cover for a colleague on leave, so you will work closely with your PMO colleagues to pick up the portfolio and keep projects on track.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard. Your projects will be varied, so you will build new skills across IT, equipment and validation, and learn alongside experienced colleagues in the PMO. We value clear expectations, honest feedback and results, so you will know what good looks like and be recognised for delivering it.

The role is a 12-month temporary position, based in Hillerød, Denmark.

What we offer

At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 570,200 to DKK 838,100, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take ownership of production projects that help bring treatments to more people, apply for the Project Manager role by 7 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Norwegian speaking telesales agent
jobs.description:

- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. 

Qualities we highly value from you:
- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone
- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team
- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people
- A competitive and result-oriented mindset
- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)
- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes
- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment
- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction
- Helpful and motivated colleagues
- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.
- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

You don't need to have experience with insurances or experience working with the financial sector to apply for this job.
It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

What you’ll bring

• 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, for example in manufacturing support, clinical or regulatory writing, or Regulatory Affairs.
