jobs.occupation: Product Marketing Manager - B2B Software for Manufacturers
jobs.description:
Highlights:

• Fast-growing B2B software platform with established global reach is looking for our first marketing hire.

• We have a broad, multi-product offering for a narrow industry, and we don't fit into a single existing "category box" as defined today -- giving you a meaty challenge to work with.

• We have large customers and touch a lot of users (as a platform for managing global supply-chains), so your work will be "heard around the world"

• We are a small, efficient, get-stuff-done team. Looking for someone who things that's the way to go.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality — with a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth. We have done very little marketing.

That is where you come in.

The role

This is our first marketing hire.

You will own positioning, messaging and sales enablement for a platform that already has real customers, real reference stories and real competitive wins — but no one whose job it is to articulate any of it. There is no existing playbook to inherit, no legacy brand guidelines to work around, and no committee to navigate. There is a large amount of low-hanging fruit and a clear runway to make a visible commercial impact within your first few months.

You will work directly and closely with our co-founder and CEO, who continues to run product. He knows the product and the domain deeply; what he needs is a strong product marketing partner to turn that into sharp positioning, messaging that lands with procurement, quality and operations buyers, and material that makes the sales conversation easier.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will be writing the copy, building the deck and updating the website — not briefing an agency to do it.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and in this role in particular, the close working relationship with management & sales is much easier to build in person.

What you will do

• Own positioning and messaging for the Supplios platform and its individual modules, and make it consistent across every touchpoint

• Translate technical capability into buyer-relevant value for distinct personas — sourcing and procurement leads, supplier quality engineers, quality directors, supply chain and operations management

• Build the sales enablement layer: pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives, proposal content and objection handling

• Run competitive and market intelligence, and keep the team honest about where we genuinely win and where we do not

• Plan and execute go-to-market for new modules and major releases, in step with the product roadmap

• Develop customer proof — case studies, reference stories and use cases — from an installed base that has plenty to say

• Rebuild our website messaging and product pages so they reflect what we actually do and who we do it for

• Feed structured market and customer insight back into product decisions

What we are looking for

Essential

• Proven product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with responsibility for positioning, messaging and sales enablement

• A demonstrable track record of translating complex, technical products into clear commercial value propositions

• Excellent written English

• Comfort operating without a marketing team, an established playbook or a large budget — you scope the work, then do it

• The temperament for a small, senior, fast-moving company: high ownership, low ceremony

Nice to have

• Domain knowledge in automotive, industrial manufacturing or supply chain. Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. We can teach the domain to the right marketer; we cannot teach product marketing to a domain expert.

• Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

• Experience as an early marketing hire at a growing B2B software company

Language

• English is the only important language for this position — we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• First marketing hire, not the fifth. You define how this company talks about itself.

• A product that already works. Real global customers in a demanding vertical, and reference stories waiting to be told.

• Work directly with the CEO/founders. No layers between you and the decisions.

• Visible impact. In a company that has barely marketed, good product marketing shows up in the pipeline quickly.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Predictive Human Digital Twins for Human-Centred Systems Engineering – DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Are you interested in human-centred engineering at the intersection of biomechanics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering, and want to build a strong methodological profile, this PhD position offers a unique opportunity – including the chance to help shape a new research group from the start.

At DTU Construct, you will develop methods that turn generic musculoskeletal models into personalised Human Digital Twins – based on sparse wearable sensor data instead of costly laboratory measurements or medical imaging – and assess how reliably they predict how a person moves and interacts with technical systems such as collaborative robots or assistive devices. The project is part of building up a new research group in Human-Centred Design within the Human-Centred Systems Engineering activities at DTU Construct. As part of the DTU PhD programme, you will follow PhD-level courses and contribute to teaching.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall purpose will be to develop and validate methods for personalising biomechanical Human Digital Twins from sparse sensor data, combining physics-based and data-driven approaches and quantifying the gap between simulation and reality (sim2real).

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Develop methods for personalising musculoskeletal models from sparse multimodal sensor data.
• Combine physics-based and data-driven approaches for model calibration and prediction.
• Quantify and reduce the sim2real gap of Human Digital Twins.
• Plan and carry out experimental studies with human participants.
• Implement your methods in open, reusable software.
• Publish your results and collaborate with researchers at DTU and international partners.
We are looking for a motivated candidate with:

• An MSc in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Design, or a related field.
• Solid programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, C++).
• A background in simulation, optimisation, machine learning, sensor processing, or parameter estimation.
• A strong interest in computational modelling of humans and human-technology systems.
• Good communication skills in English and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
• Experience with musculoskeletal modelling (e.g. OpenSim, AnyBody, SCONE), motion analysis, or wearable sensing is an advantage.
• We do not expect you to master all of these areas – a solid foundation and the motivation to grow into the field matter most.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Jörg Miehling.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Jörg Miehling, jormi@dtu.dk (please mention “PhD Position Inquiry” in your email subject).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk and the Section at www.construct.dtu.dk/sections/engineering-design-and-manufacturing-systems.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 2 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of your BSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your MSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your scientific articles (if any) published so far (in pdf)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

The Section of Engineering Design and Manufacturing Systems (EDM) advances the design of intelligent, resilient, and sustainable products and manufacturing systems, integrating systems engineering, modular architectures, robust and bio-inspired design, and AI-enabled engineering.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Event Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to help create experiences that surprise and inspire, and fill ÅBEN’s bars with life?

Events give guests a new way to meet ÅBEN. Whether it’s a spontaneous quiz night or a planned company celebration, it’s about inviting guests into the universe and giving them an experience they’ll remember.

We are looking for a sales-driven and hands-on Event Manager who will take responsibility for developing the events area into a stronger part of the bars, from proactive sales and idea development to planning and execution. Success is about bringing more guests into the bars and strengthening revenue through events and private bookings.

Your responsibilities

You will be part of Operations and report to the Bar Operations Manager. You will be working closely with the individual Bar Managers and the Event Coordinator for Kødbyen on a daily basis. The position is anchored in the bars and on the events that are part of everyday life at ÅBEN, both commercial bookings and the public, recurring formats. Brand and partnership events are run by Marketing, but you will work closely with the team to develop and sharpen them. You will also stay in close dialogue with Marketing, so that all formats live up to ÅBEN’s values: creating joy through experiences, daring to walk our own path, making an effort, and doing the right thing, even when no one is watching.

Event Manager is a new role, which gives you the opportunity to shape it from the very beginning. This means a responsibility to create structure and direction, and the freedom to test new ideas and shape how events work across the bars. Your responsibilities cover a wide range:

• 
Proactive sales and day-to-day dialogue with both private guests and companies.

• 
Project management from first enquiry to final follow-up, including pricing, budgets, planning and review.

• 
Development of new concepts and recurring formats that fit the bars and turn first-time guests into regulars.

• 
Optimising sales channels, booking sites and internal processes to make the most of the bars’ capacity.

• 
Synergy and shared standards across the bars, with room to find what works for each individual bar.

• 
Presence at larger events to ensure quality and support the bar staff.

Who are you?

We expect you to thrive in a fast-paced environment with an informal tone and a flat structure. You have a strong eye for the big picture, naturally take the lead and can balance structure at the desk with presence on the floor. We imagine that you:

Have at least 3 years of experience with sales, planning and running events, preferably from the restaurant, hotel or entertainment industry.

Have a good commercial understanding and find it motivating to work with sales targets, budgets and getting the most out of every bar.

Are a strong communicator and relationship builder who works effortlessly with both guests and bar staff.

Becoming part of ÅBEN means stepping into an organisation in development with both ambitions and its heart in the right place. There is room to grow, take responsibility and have fun along the way.

Interviews are held continuously, so send your application today if the role of Event Manager at ÅBEN sounds like something for you.

jobs.occupation: Student assistant in Customer Care & Business Operation
jobs.description:
At MODU, we design modular building toys developed with a focus on active play and great design. Right now, we are looking for a structured and service-minded part-time colleague or student assistant to help us support our customers during busy peak periods and ensure smooth B2B order logistics — acting as the vital link between our Customer Care, Sales, and Logistics teams.

Your main responsibilities:

• 
Assist our Customer Care team during busy peak periods by answering inquiries from customers across Europe via email and chat

• 
Process, coordinate, and track B2B orders to ensure timely and accurate deliveries to our retail partners

• 
Act as the daily bridge between Customer Care, Sales, and our external warehouse/logistics partners

• 
Proactively follow up on shipments, resolve delivery issues, and handle claims or missing items

• 
Keep order systems and customer data updated and organized

We imagine that you:

• 
Are naturally structured, detail-oriented, and great at keeping a cool head during busy periods

• 
Love solving problems and take pride in following tasks all the way to the finish line

• 
Can work independently and stay connected with the team, whether you are at the office or working from home

• 
Communicate effortlessly and professionally in English (written and spoken)—additional European languages like Danish, German, or French are a big plus

• 
Experience with Shopify and CRM systems are a plus

• 
Are looking for a flexible part-time job alongside your studies or other commitments (experience from customer support or coordination is a plus, but not a requirement)

Practical details:

• 
Employment type: 10-15 hours pr. week / Student position (hourly paid), with flexible hours and extra shifts during peak seasons

• 
Location: Hybrid — a mix of our office in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, and remote work (much of the work can be done remotely)

• 
Application deadline: November 15, 2026

• 
Start date: As soon as possible / Upon agreement

Sounds like the right job for you? We look forward to hearing from you. Send your short application and CV as soon as possible, as we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

We encourage all candidates, regardless of gender, age, and background, to apply, and we welcome applications where personal information is kept anonymous or omitted.

Read more about us at www.modutoy.com.

For more information or questions please contact us at clara@modu.dk

jobs.occupation: Service Project Leader
jobs.description:
**About Us:

**Afinitas, med hovedkontor i St. Louis, Missouri, er en global leder inden for udstyr, formningssystemer og vigtige tilbehørsprodukter, der understøtter transport, vand og forsyning af præfabrikerede betoninfrastrukturer over hele verden. Vi leverer brancheførende produktionsudstyr, højtudviklet forskalling og et bredt sortiment af præfabrikerede beton-, el- og byggetilbehør samt strukturelle produkter og systemer designet til bro-, motorvejs- og tunge byggeprojekter. Afinitas er en del af BW Forsyth Partners, LLC, investeringsgruppen under det globale produktions- og ingeniørkonsulentfirma Barry-Wehmiller, en organisation med en omsætning på 3 milliarder dollars og næsten 12.000 medarbejdere, der er forenet af en fælles overbevisning: at bruge forretningens styrke til at skabe en bedre verden.

**Job Description:

**The Service Project Leader will be responsible for providing project management leadership across our Equipment and Automation (E&A) European Service organisation in Denmark and Germany, working to deliver projects to our customers within scope, budget, and timeline.

This role will lead small to large and complex customer service projects whilst actively engaging in our Lean journey by building and acting on continuous improvement and development opportunities focused on building Customer Trust.

**Essential Functions & Responsiblities

**

• Provide Project Management leadership to defined projects, primarily from shipment to final handover, including the support of system installation at the customer’s site to final acceptance testing and project sign-off.

• Lead internal and external project communication, as well as coordinating work to ensure alignment of schedules.

• Identify when additional skills or resources are required to ensure successful project execution and help to secure these.

• Create and own project plans, monitor progress against plans, set deadlines and manage the project lifecycle.

• Provide Leadership to the business to help create processes and Standard Work for Project Management.

• Supporting Alliance Service contract renewal and scheduling of Service visits

• Supporting remote service - Acts as a remote service backup, providing online customer support for PLC controlled systems.

• Help develop Project Management skills with other E&A team members.

• Participate in Continuous Improvement activity within E&A.

• Evaluate project performance by collecting, maintaining, and communicating lessons learned and ensure that standard work is modified and shared accordingly.

**Qualifications & Abilities

**

• Ideally educated in an Engineering discipline (electric engineering, marine engineer, electro/mechanic technology degree) with minimum 5+ years of related engineering and project management experience, within manufacturing plant industries.

• Strong team working skills with the ability to collaborate effectively, partnering across multiple departments, with a capacity for listening and absorbing different points of view.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and prioritize effectively.

• Excellent communication skills and passion for connecting with others.

• Use judgement to make complex decisions to solve difficult and complex problems.

• Combination of technical competence, business perspective and customer interaction required.

• Demonstrated ability to understand strategic goals and then implement technical solutions to achieve these goals.

• Ideally hold a recognized project management qualification.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT

**This is an office position associated with a manufacturing facility, with travel to customer plants. The employee must be able to correctly wear and use any Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required by the employer when in manufacturing areas.

**CORE COMPETENCIES

**Communicates effectively – developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus – building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results – consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity – making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes: knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Persuades: using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others

Plans and aligns: planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Resourcefulness – adapts to changing circumstances and priorities; effectively copes with unexpected interruptions, delays, and demands.

Situational adaptability - adapting approach and demeanour in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Strategic mindset: seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

_At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

**Afinitas

jobs.occupation: E-tail Coordinator
jobs.description:

You’ll work together with the sales team with top-tier e-tailers to drive brand awareness, visibility, conversion, and sales of Audo´s iconic design products

Your Role and Focus Areas

Together with the local sales teams, you will support and enable our e-tailer sales performance across markets. Your role is to coordinate, align and strengthen e-tail partnerships and activities across borders and provide the local sales teams with the data, insights and support to succeed.

In this role, you will:

• Secure and exceed sales targets through structured online sales initiatives

• Manage and develop relationships with key e-tailers in EMEA together with the local sales team

• Identify new digital opportunities and align with our broader company retail strategy

• Promote the Audo brand through marketing activations and ensure full visibility of product portfolio and commercial campaign planning

• Support partners with insights, Master Data and digital activation

How You’ll Make an Impact

Your success will be measured by how you succeed executing the company´s strategy of our e-tail channel together with the local sales teams.

Key success indicators include:

• Implementation and execution of the e-tail strategy together with the local sales teams

• Growth in e-tail revenue and new product sales

• Drive brand awareness through strategic marketing initiatives

• Strong performance in digital campaigns (Traffic, Call-To-Action, Conversion)

Working Smarter with Data

Your Profile

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in e-tail sales

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing tools and portals

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

• Fluency in English

What Drives You

Your mindset is just as important as your skillset. We’re seeking someone who’s hands-on, data-driven, and eager to push boundaries in the e-tail business.

We believe you are:

• Self-motivated and proactive, with a natural drive for results

• Structured and analytical, with strong planning capabilities

• Customer-oriented with a passion for building value-adding partnerships

• A collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment

Why join us?

• An exciting opportunity to join an ambitious company

• Become part of a diverse, collaborative, and dynamic sales team, reporting directly to the Sales Director – Wholesale & E-tail, European Core Markets

• Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and qualifications

• You will work from our unique Head Office in Nordhavn

• Flexible and collaborative working culture

Excited to develop e-tail business for a brand where design meets purpose?

We’d love to hear from you - please don’t hesitate to apply by submitting your CV and Cover Letter, describing why you are the right fit for this position and why you are interested in joining us.

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Senior QA Engineer, Defence
jobs.description:
Do you like testing complex systems and working closely with developers? We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Product Extension Team in Copenhagen. You will bring senior test expertise to a small team that builds integrations and extensions for Systematic's defence products, with real influence on how we test and improve.

The job

As the team's senior tester, you will be its quality advocate, driving how we test and improve across the full development lifecycle. You will combine hands-on test execution with real influence over our testing tools, methods and processes.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning, estimating and executing test activities, and contributing to test estimates in project planning

• Driving quality across the development lifecycle through risk-based test design

• Developing and maintaining system-level automated tests that support feature testing

• Challenging developers and projects on where automation makes the most sense, including weak points in developer-driven tests

• Improving our test tools, methods and processes

You should expect occasional travel of around five to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team in Defence Services, around seven developers, test engineers and architects. The team delivers software and hardware integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability solutions with external systems, so our customers get functionality tailored to their needs without compromising on quality or maintainability. As the team's senior tester, you will work closely with developers, architects, project management, external system providers and customer representatives, and share your knowledge by mentoring our junior test engineer and running workshops.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience in software and/or systems testing, along with:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Experience with test management and test design methods

• The ability to drive the implementation of test frameworks and tools, and to review and adapt existing automated test setups

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, protocols and hardware validation setups

• Experience with tools like JUnit, Cucumber, Playwright, Jira, Xray, Karma and TeamCity, or similar

• Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

ISTQB Foundation certification, or similar, is an advantage but not a requirement.

Alongside this, we value:

• A proactive and independent approach, with strong analytical skills and a risk-based mindset

• An ability to build relationships and work across teams and projects

• Curiosity about customer needs and how the system is actually used

• A willingness to share information openly and help others learn

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

jobs.occupation: M&A Associate, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and gain hands-on experience across the full deal lifecycle in an international company with ambitious growth plans?

We are looking for an M&A Associate, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and support the execution of our M&A strategy and broader strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work across the full M&A process, from identifying and evaluating potential acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will work closely with key stakeholders across the organization, combining financial analysis with strategic and commercial insights to support important investment decisions.

The role offers early responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close interaction with senior management within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Copenhagen office three days per week.

Your role

As an M&A Associate in Corporate Development, your primary responsibility will be to support the development and execution of KK's M&A strategy.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Support the execution of M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Prepare investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify potential acquisition targets and assess new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support post-acquisition integration planning, including identification and assessment of potential synergies.

• Support broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Your profile

We expect you to have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities.

• A good commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations.

• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured decision material.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions clearly.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organizational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to take responsibility. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and contribute actively.

Ready to build your M&A experience, take responsibility early on and contribute to KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Quality Control Manager
jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Join Our Team as a Quality Control Manager

**We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Manager to lead and develop our incoming quality control activities. This is a key role within our organization, ensuring that incoming materials and components meet quality requirements while supporting continuous improvement across our operations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining product quality, driving process improvements, and supporting production through strong quality leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Incoming Quality Control

**

• Take overall responsibility for Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities.

• Ensure all incoming materials, components, and products comply with established quality requirements and specifications.

• Investigate and manage supplier-related quality issues and non-conformances.

• Work closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to resolve quality concerns.

**Process Development and Improvement

**

• Lead the implementation of new procedures and standards for incoming inspection processes.

• Continuously improve inspection methods, quality controls, and efficiency.

• Develop and maintain inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and quality documentation.

• Support supplier qualification and supplier quality improvement initiatives.

**Quality Documentation

**

• Own and maintain controlled documents related to Quality Control activities.

• Ensure procedures, work instructions, forms, and records are current, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and internal requirements.

• Support internal and external audits as required.

**Team Leadership

**

• Directly manage and develop one QC Technician.

• Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and support employee development.

• Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Operational Support

**

• Participate in daily production meetings and provide quality-related input.

• Collaborate with production teams to address quality concerns and minimize disruptions.

• Support root cause investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.

• Monitor quality performance and drive actions to improve product and process quality.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, or Manufacturing Quality.

• Previous leadership experience is preferred.

• Experience with incoming inspection processes and supplier quality management.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001 and other relevant quality management systems.

• Strong knowledge of incoming inspection methodologies, AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) sampling plans, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality management software systems.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**Personal Competencies

**We are looking for a candidate who is:

• Structured and detail-oriented.

• Proactive and solution-focused.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• A strong communicator with excellent collaboration skills.

• Results driven with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Capable of balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.

**What We Offer

**

• An exciting opportunity to shape and improve our quality processes.

• A collaborative and professional working environment.

• Opportunities for personal and professional development.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• The chance to make a significant impact on product quality and operational excellence.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract and Warranty Manager – Hobro, Denmark
jobs.description:
Do you have experience in managing complex operations contracts and commercial risk across countries? Do you enjoy building something into the next level?

We are looking for a Senior Contract and Warranty Manager to take end-to-end ownership of operations contracts across Eurowind Energy's global wind, solar and BESS portfolio.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Contract and Warranty Manager to join our Global Operations team. Based at our Operations office in Hobro, you will be the contract and warranty specialist for our global asset portfolio, supporting colleagues and managers across countries and functions.

Your role

As Senior Contract and Warranty Manager, you will take ownership of key commercial agreements, claims and warranty matters across Eurowind Energy's global asset portfolio. You will work closely with Asset Management, Operations, Finance, Legal and local teams to ensure that our contractual rights are understood, protected and actively used. The role combines hands-on contract management with a strong focus on risk, value creation and standardization across markets.

• Own contract management for operations contracts, including service and O&M agreements, warranty and performance guarantees, grid connection and curtailment compensation, insurance, land lease and supplier agreements

• Lead negotiation, drafting and execution of contracts so they meet both legal and commercial requirements

• Identify, assess and mitigate commercial and legal risk across the contract portfolio

• Manage claims and warranty follow-up, making sure issues are tracked, escalated and resolved in line with contractual terms

• Build global contract templates, playbooks and governance processes that work consistently across countries

• Monitor contract performance and compliance, flagging risks and improvement opportunities

• Be the go-to contact for the country teams and the wider operations organisation on contract questions and disputes

You will work with the country operations teams, Strategic Commercial Management (which owns PPAs, power trading and balancing contracts), Technical Operations, Investor Administration, SCADA Operations, Legal, Finance, and suppliers and service providers. Your role is to strengthen the countries' ability to manage contracts locally, not to add another layer of bureaucracy.

What we offer

You will join Global Operations at a time where we are transforming how we manage and operate our global asset portfolio. You will get a broad international scope, close collaboration across functions and countries, and the opportunity to work with complex commercial and operational challenges. We offer a high level of autonomy, a strong professional environment and the opportunity to make a visible impact on how Eurowind operates.

• A newly created role where you set the structures and ways of working

• The chance to make a real impact on how we improve and operate our commercial mindset

• Ownership, trust and room to shape your own area

• A global role with some travel, in an international and energetic environment

• A workplace in Hobro, alongside our operations colleagues

You will join a newly established team and report to Louise Guldager Thomsen, Head of Global Commercial Management. Louise is a collaborative and pragmatic leader who builds strong relationships, creates alignment across functions and empowers people to take ownership. She combines a deep understanding of the organisation with a practical focus on execution and a global perspective.

Required competencies and skills

You have solid experience with contract management, commercial agreements, warranties and/or claims, ideally from the energy, infrastructure, construction or other asset-intensive industries. You are comfortable navigating complex contractual matters and working across technical, commercial and legal topics. You combine strong analytical and negotiation skills with a pragmatic approach and the ability to turn contractual knowledge into action and business value.

• Significant experience in contract management within energy, infrastructure, renewables or another asset-intensive industry

• A proven record of leading complex contract negotiations end-to-end, including service and O&M, warranty, grid/curtailment, insurance and supplier contracts

• Solid understanding of commercial and legal risk management, with experience building or applying compliance frameworks

• Relevant legal, commercial or technical education (for example law, business or engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience

• International experience and comfort working across countries and cultures

• Enjoys building something new and setting up structures from scratch

• Works autonomously across a global organisation and values being part of a team

• Structured and detail-oriented, yet pragmatic about getting things done without unnecessary process

• Communicates clearly and directly, holding suppliers and internal stakeholders accountable while working with respect

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Read more about Eurowind Energy A/S on our website or LinkedIn

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV as soon as possible.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Louise Guldager Thomsen, Head of Global Commercial Management, at lth@ewe.dk.

Application deadline: 30 November 2026

Place of work: Hobro, Denmark

jobs.occupation: Global Cyber Security Consultant
jobs.description:
Do you want to help protect critical energy infrastructure at the heart of the green transition? Are you energised by working directly with local businesses across Europe, understanding their challenges and mobilising the right expertise to solve them?

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Global Cyber Security Consultant to join our team in Hobro, Denmark.

As an operator of critical energy infrastructure, cybersecurity is a vital part of how we protect our business, our partners and the communities we serve. As Eurowind continues to grow and adapt to an evolving threat landscape and regulatory requirements such as NIS2, we are strengthening security as an integrated part of the organisation – in every market where we operate.

You will join our Group Cyber and Information Security team – a small, senior team supporting a global organisation, anchored directly with the CISO. Cyber and information security is delivered centrally from Group headquarters to all our markets, and we do not scale through headcount alone, but through expertise, smart automation and AI. That means real ownership, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to shape how security is delivered across Eurowind.

Your role

This is a new and highly visible role. As Group Cyber Security Advisor, you are Group Cyber and Information Security’s face in our 14 markets. You build trusted relationships with country management and site teams – remotely and, when it adds value, on site – and uncover where they need help within cyber and information security – from regulatory compliance and supplier risk to securing operational technology at our energy parks.

You will not solve everything yourself, and you are not expected to. Behind you stands the full Group organisation: security operations, architecture, GRC and legal specialists who deliver the concrete solutions. Your job is to identify the need, activate the right expertise at headquarters, and support the local organisation through implementation – so our markets get consistent, high-quality security support from within the Group instead of relying on external consultants.

Your work will include:

• Acting as the primary point of contact for cyber and information security in our local markets and building strong relationships with country management

• Conducting structured assessments of local needs, risks and maturity – across IT, OT and compliance – using a common Group framework

• Translating local needs into concrete deliveries from Group specialists in security operations, GRC, legal and architecture

• Supporting local implementation of Group security initiatives, standards and controls, including NIS2, ISO 27001 and IEC 62443 requirements

• Making our markets aware of the security services already available to them through the Group, reducing the need for external advisors

• Reporting findings, progress and risks back to the CISO and contributing to Group-level prioritisation

What we offer

We believe security starts with understanding the business: what needs protecting, why it matters and how security can help the organisation move faster and more safely. That is exactly what this role embodies – security delivered in partnership with the business, not imposed on it.

Our role is not to block progress, but to help Eurowind operate securely and confidently globally, under NIS2 and in an increasingly demanding threat landscape.

We also believe good security starts with strong fundamentals. It is easy to chase the cutting edge, but most organisations are exposed because the basics are not consistently in place. For us, that means strong visibility, reliable detection and well-practised response – consistently, in every market. We do not dismiss bold ideas – we build the foundation that makes them viable.

Just as importantly, we believe better security comes from building a better team. We value people who challenge assumptions, think independently and bring different perspectives. Leadership in our team is about creating the conditions for better answers to emerge, not pretending to have all the answers.

In return, you will get:

• A unique, self-directed role with international reach and direct impact across 14 countries

• Direct anchoring with the CISO and close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the Group

• A strong specialist backline – you are the front figure, never alone with the problem

• Access to modern AI tools and automation to amplify your impact

• Pension and health insurance

• Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model based at our headquarters in Hobro – with the opportunity to travel to our European markets when it makes a difference

Required competencies and skills

This role is less about deep technical specialisation and more about judgement, communication and drive. You are comfortable walking into a country office or an energy park and earning trust quickly – whether you are talking to a country manager, a site technician or a local lawyer. You can hold a conversation about regulatory obligations in the morning and OT security at a substation in the afternoon, and you know when to bring in a specialist.

We imagine you bring:

jobs.description:
Do you want to make sure that when something goes wrong, our organisation already knows what to do? Are you energised by building capability and confidence in others, rather than being the one who has to solve every incident yourself?

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Global Resilience Consultant to join our team in Hobro, Denmark.

As an operator of critical energy infrastructure, our ability to respond when things go wrong is fundamental to protecting our business, our partners and the communities we serve. As Eurowind continues to grow and face an evolving risk landscape and regulatory requirements such as NIS2, we are strengthening emergency preparedness as an integrated part of the organisation – in every market where we operate.

You will join our Group Cyber and Information Security team – a small, senior team supporting a global organisation, anchored directly with the CISO. Emergency preparedness is coordinated centrally from Group headquarters across all our markets, and we do not scale through headcount alone, but through clear plans, practised people and smart use of technology. That means real ownership, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to shape how prepared Eurowind is when it matters most.

Your role

This is a new and highly visible role. As Group Emergency Preparedness Advisor, you own that Eurowind is ready before a crisis happens – not that you personally run the response when one occurs. You make sure our global emergency preparedness has the plans it needs, that those plans are kept current and fit for purpose across all markets, and that the people who will use them are trained and confident enough to act.

You will not run our incident response or crisis management yourself, and you are not expected to. That responsibility stays with the teams and leaders whose job it is to respond when something happens. Your job is to build and maintain the framework behind them – the plans, the training and the exercises – so that when a crisis hits, everyone already knows their role.

Your work will include:

• Owning Eurowind’s global emergency preparedness framework – making sure the crisis management, business continuity and incident response plans we need actually exist, across all markets

• Mapping which plans are in place, where, and identifying and closing gaps together with local management and Group functionsin

• Driving larger, cross-market crisis exercises as well as frequent smaller micro-exercises – so readiness is tested and kept sharp continuously, not just checked off once a year

• Making sure plans and training cover the full range of scenarios relevant to Eurowind – from cyber incidents to safety events, operational disruptions and OT/critical infrastructure incidents

• Working with country management, Group functions such as security, legal, communications and HR, and site teams to keep plans realistic and grounded in how the organisation actually operates

• Reporting on preparedness status, training coverage and identified gaps back to the CISO and contributing to Group-level prioritisation

What we offer

We believe preparedness only counts if it works under pressure. A plan nobody has practised is not a plan – it is a document. That is exactly what this role is about: making sure Eurowind is drilled, not just documented.

We are moving towards an approach that is more structured, tested and better integrated across the business. Our role is not to own every response, but to make sure Eurowind can respond – confidently and consistently – globally, under NIS2 and in an increasingly demanding risk landscape.

We also believe good preparedness starts with strong fundamentals. It is easy to write an impressive plan, but most organisations are exposed because the basics are not consistently trained and practised. For us, that means clear ownership, tested plans and people who know what to do – consistently, in every market. We do not dismiss ambition – we build the foundation that makes it viable.

Just as importantly, we believe better preparedness comes from building a better team. We value people who challenge assumptions, think independently and bring different perspectives. Leadership in our team is about creating the conditions for better answers to emerge, not pretending to have all the answers.

In return, you will get:

• A unique, self-directed role with international reach and direct impact across 14 countries

• Direct anchoring with the CISO and close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the Group

• A clear mandate to build capability rather than carry the operational burden alone – you own the framework, not every incident

• Access to modern AI tools and automation to amplify your impact

• Pension and health insurance

• Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model based at our headquarters in Hobro – with the opportunity to travel to our European markets when it makes a difference

Required competencies and skills

This role is less about being the person in the room during a crisis, and more about the discipline and drive to make sure everyone else knows what to do when they are. You are comfortable walking into a country office or an energy park and earning trust quickly – whether you are talking to a country manager, a site technician or a Group specialist. You know how to turn “we should probably have a plan for that” into a plan people have actually practised.

We imagine you bring:

•

jobs.occupation: Diagnostic & Scientific Liaison - Oncology (Denmark) – Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
Are you ready to accelerate high-quality biomarker testing so the right patients receive the right treatment, faster? As a Diagnostic and Scientific Liaison, you will be the in-country scientific expert who turns strategy into practical testing solutions that directly impact patient identification and care in your assigned Nordic country. the testing landscape so clinicians have the evidence they need when it matters most?

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

You will build trusted partnerships with laboratory leaders, pathologists, molecular specialists, and oncologists, bringing scientific clarity and technical guidance to every interaction. Working cross-functionally, you will translate Nordic and global diagnostic direction into focused country plans, remove barriers to timely testing, and help ensure robust, reliable diagnostics are available across the patient journey.

Accountabilities:

• 
Shape Diagnostic Strategy: Assess the country’s diagnostic landscape, patient pathways and laboratory capacity, translating insights into practical testing plans aligned with Nordic and global priorities.

• 
Build Scientific Partnerships: Engage laboratory leaders and scientific experts related to the brands and their diagnostic challenge through trusted relationships, education and tailored technical communication.

• 
Drive Brand science in context to the diagnostic strategy. Work holistically with the scientific experts ensuring they buy fully in to the science behind the in line or future brands and the need for diagnosing the right target segment.

• 
Improve Testing Quality and Access: Identify barriers and bottlenecks, champion quality and appropriate testing, and co-create compliant solutions that improve timeliness and equity.

• 
Generate Insights and Evidence: Provide diagnostic intelligence to support launches, tactical planning, validation, real-world evidence, and research initiatives.

• 
Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Drive priorities from planning to delivery, collaborating across country, Nordic and global teams to improve consistency, quality and efficiency.

• 
Uphold Governance and Compliance: Ensure all activities meet the highest scientific, ethical, privacy, safety, quality and compliance standards, escalating risks appropriately.

Essential Skills/Experience:

• 
Relevant Background: Degree in life sciences, biomedical science, medicine, pharmacy or a related field, with approximately 3–5 years’ experience in diagnostics, biomarker testing, clinical laboratories or healthcare.

• 
Diagnostic Expertise: Working knowledge of diagnostic pathways, laboratory operations and testing methodologies, with confidence interpreting scientific and technical data.

• 
Communication and Influence: Ability to explain complex science clearly, deliver compelling technical presentations, and build trusted external relationships.

• 
Project Delivery: Strong planning, prioritisation and stakeholder-management skills, with a track record of delivering projects in matrix organisations.

• 
Language and Mobility: Fluency in English and the relevant local Nordic language, with willingness to travel regularly in-country and across the Nordics as needed.

• 
Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based role.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• 
Advanced Expertise: Advanced degree or experience in oncology diagnostics, companion diagnostics or biomarker testing, including IHC, NGS or PCR.

• 
Industry Experience: Background in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics or clinical laboratory environments.

• 
Quality and Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of local diagnostic regulations and quality-assurance requirements.

• 
Stakeholder and Launch Experience: Experience partnering with laboratories, healthcare professionals and diagnostic providers, and supporting launches, testing implementation, validation, research or real-world evidence initiatives.

• 
Nordic Collaboration: Experience contributing to cross-country or Nordic projects.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Why AstraZeneca

Join a team where science leads decisions, and collaboration turns evidence into real change for people living with cancer. Here, unexpected teams gather around the same table to unleash bold thinking, fusing medical expertise with strategic execution to change clinical practice. You will work at the forefront of diagnostics, partnering with external experts and cross-functional colleagues to shape every point in the patient journey. We back ambition with support, value kindness alongside high standards, and create space to test new ideas, learn quickly and scale what works—so your contribution reaches patients, not just slide decks.

So, what is next?

Step into this pivotal role to elevate precision diagnostics in your country and help transform cancer care - bring your scientific credibility and project leadership to where they’ll make the biggest impact today.

Welcome with your application, in English, latest by the 15th of November 2026!

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Project Manager in Procurement Excellence in Corporate Procurement, you will lead and deliver highly complex projects related to global technology implementations, AI initiatives and more. You will be the trusted partner to our Line of Business, bringing stakeholders on all levels, data and ideas together to keep projects on track and make sure the value is realised. Your work helps Corporate Procurement respond to complex, cross-regional needs with clarity and pace, so Novo can move closer to its purpose of driving change for lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced project leader who is comfortable in senior discussions, structures complexity quickly and brings others with you. You will have:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain or a related field.

• A minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience.

• Demonstrated experience with consulting toolbox, frameworks and approaches and with working with stakeholders on all levels.

• Experience in large, global technology implementation projects where you have brought the solutions end-to-end to your business stakeholders.

• Direct or indirect people management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead a team or project team.

• Strong project management skills, including managing multiple complex projects, prioritising resources and managing risks and issues at a strategic level.

• The ability to bring data from multiple sources together into clear insights and recommendations.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including with executive leadership and global audiences, and the discretion to handle sensitive information.

• An international mindset and the ability to drive change in a global environment.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience working with or implementing Coupa and Rossum.

• Procurement experience.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead projects across Procurement Excellence from first plan to realised value, while keeping stakeholders aligned along the way.

• Plan and execute highly complex technology implementation projects, AI initiatives and similar for Procurement Excellence, coordinating activities, managing resources and tracking progress to deliver on time and on objectives.

• Anchor project outcomes and make sure the value is realised, with clear responsibilities for everyone involved.

• Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, and act as the primary point of contact for the complex and cross-regional needs of business units.

• Lead the alignment of business unit needs and concerns with global strategy.

• Oversee the analysis of complex project data and trends, and drive problem solving that turns insight into better project decisions and new ways of working.

• Communicate project status, developments and key insights to executive leadership, and manage stakeholder expectations so objectives stay aligned.

• Mentor and develop less experienced colleagues, and act as a sparring partner to other projects.

**You will be part of the Transformation Delivery Office within Procurement Excellence in Corporate Procurement.

Your closest partners will be colleagues in IT, Global Business Services (GBS) and Corporate Procurement, as well as business units and other areas across Novo, depending on the project. You will not only work with stakeholders from a variety of functions and locations but also of different levels, ranging from senior management presentations to getting stakeholders and future users of the solutions on board.

You will work across regions and functions, bringing different perspectives together, creating clarity on priorities and helping teams move quickly from plan to delivery.

You will report to Associate Director of the Transformation Delivery Office.
