jobs.occupation: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS    The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.    About the role   We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs.   We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues.      Key responsibilities    Website management:    	
•  	Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.  	    	
•  	Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.  	    	
•  	Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.  	   Graphic design & visual content:    	
•  	Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.  	    	
•  	Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.  	    	
•  	Video editing & multimedia:  	    	
•  	Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.  	    	
•  	Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.  	   Social media support :    	
•  	Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.  	    	
•  	Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.  	   Internal communications support:    	
•  	Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.  	    	
•  	Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.  	   Press Office and external communications support:    	
•  	Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.  	    	
•  	Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.  	    	
•  	Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.  	   Data and stakeholder information management:    	
•  	Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.  	    	
•  	Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.   	      Desired profile    We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease.   Required qualifications:    	
•  	Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.  	    	
•  	Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.  	    	
•  	Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.  	    	
•  	Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.  	    	
•  	Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.  	    	
•  	Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.  	    	
•  	Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.  	    	
•  	Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.  	    	
•  	Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.  	   Preferred qualifications:    	
•  	Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.  	    	
•  	Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)  	    	
•  	Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.  	      What we offer     	
•  	Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.  	    	
•  	Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.  	    	
•  	Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.  	    	
•  	International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.  	   If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you!      Terms of employment   The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees.   The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark.      Application and recruitment process     Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying.     We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026.   For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition.   We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description: Job description:Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.The role:You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto's drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).What you will do:- Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.- Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.- Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.- Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.- Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.- Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.- Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.- Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.- Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.- You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.- You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.- You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.- If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.- You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.What we are looking for:We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.- At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.- Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.- Strong C++ programming skills.- Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.- Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.- Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.- Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.- Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.- Professional fluency in English.- A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.Who you are:You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.- You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.- You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.- You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.- You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.- You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.Minds and makers forging ahead together.At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.Why join Robotto?Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company's journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto's technology.Equal Employment Opportunity:Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.More information and application:https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8273412-embedded-software-control-engineer

jobs.occupation: Lead Game Programmer

And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here's what that looks like day to dayIn collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneckYou'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right timeOverall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build onThis includes things like...Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibilityImplementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friendsProfiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connectionsBreaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affectStaying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolvesYou're a great match ifYou have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative productionYou're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editorYou've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alikeNice to havesYou have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and SwiftExperience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online gamesInterest in multiplayer game design and social featuresExperience working with automated build pipelines such as JenkinsExperience building systemic or open-world gamesWhat always matters to us at TribandYou thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forwardYou're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that cultureYou believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyoneYou bring curiosity, generosity, and Vi søger en dygtig souschef med solid erfaring inden for fastfoodbranchen, særligt tilberedning af kebab, dürüm og burgere.

• 
Medansvar for køkkenets daglige drift og organisering.

• 
Forberedelse, tilberedning og anretning af kebab, dürüm, burgere og øvrige fastfoodretter.

• 
Sikring af korrekt tilberedning, portionsstørrelser, smag og præsentation.

• 
Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver i samarbejde med køkkenchefen.

• 
Ledelse, oplæring og vejledning af køkkenpersonale.

• 
Sikring af effektive arbejdsgange og hurtig ekspedition i travle perioder.

• 
Varebestilling, lagerstyring og kontrol af råvarernes kvalitet og friskhed.

• 
Begrænsning af madspild og sikring af optimal råvareudnyttelse.

• 
Overholdelse af gældende regler for fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne, rengøring og egenkontrol.

• 
Deltagelse i udvikling og forbedring af menuer, opskrifter og tilberedningsmetoder.

• 
Varetagelse af køkkenchefens opgaver ved dennes fravær.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har relevant erfaring som kok, køkken-souschef eller fra en lignende stilling i fastfood- eller restaurationsbranchen.

• 
Har solid praktisk erfaring med tilberedning af kebab, dürüm og burgere.

• 
Har godt kendskab til håndtering, marinering, tilberedning og servering af kød samt øvrige råvarer.

• 
Har erfaring med at arbejde i et køkken med højt tempo og mange bestillinger.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger.

• 
Har gode samarbejdsevner og kan motivere og vejlede kolleger.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og kvalitetsbevidst.

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og sikre en god arbejdsfordeling i travle perioder.

• 
Har kendskab til gældende hygiejnekrav og fødevaresikkerhed.

• 
Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

• 
Er indstillet på at arbejde om aftenen og i weekender.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasksYour work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competenciesYou have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position. 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV). 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and potential PhD diploma). 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications (optional). 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position. 
• References/recommendations. 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.    

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. Interviews are expected to be held during December 2026

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

jobs.occupation: 211-0367/26-2K Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
jobs.description:
Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen   The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems.  Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research.  The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus.  The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges.  The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg.  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.  Description of qualifications needed  The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface.  Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:   	
• Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions 	
• The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems 	
• Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems 	
• Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning 	
• Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production   The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.  The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:   	
• PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field 	
• Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture 	
• An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment 	
• Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals 	
• Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development. 	
• Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs 	
• A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills 	
• Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations. 	
• A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations. 	
• Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees 	
• Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc 	
• Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks   Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.  Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here   Salary and employment conditions  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.  Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.  Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk).   Filing of application The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.   Please include    	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers      The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.  Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027.  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0367/26-2K.

As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.

The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job

At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement.

Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission.

Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights.

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.

Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models.

Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills.

An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style.

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

• 
Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

• 
Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

• 
Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

• 
Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

• 
Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

• 
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

• 
MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

• 
Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

• 
Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

• 
Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

• 
Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

• 
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

• 
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). jobs.occupation: Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
The Center for Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position focusing on process simulation, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of large-scale Power-to-X (PtX) systems for the production of renewable fuels and chemicals. The preferred start date is February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Job Description

The PhD position is part of SDU Life Cycle Engineering's research activities on PtX technologies, renewable fuel production, sector coupling, and the transition toward climate-neutral energy systems.

PtX technologies are expected to play an important role in decarbonizing hard-to-abate sectors by converting renewable electricity into synthetic fuels, and chemicals. However, their large-scale deployment requires efficient process design, effective integration with local energy system and biomass availability, and economically competitive operation under variable renewable electricity supply and changing market conditions.

The PhD project aims to develop and apply advanced process simulation and techno-economic optimization frameworks for large-scale PtX systems. A central focus will be on linking detailed process simulations with techno-economic models to evaluate alternative process configurations, identify opportunities for sector coupling, and optimize technology capacities and operating conditions. The project will also investigate how electricity prices, renewable electricity availability, hydrogen, biogas and CO2 supply, and process flexibility influence the economic performance of industrial-scale PtX facilities. The research will combine process simulation tools, particularly Aspen Plus, with computational modelling and optimization approaches. 

The successful candidate will contribute to ongoing national and international research projects and collaborate with academic and industrial partners working on PtX technologies and sustainable energy systems.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) at the University of Southern Denmark's main campus in Odense. 

SDU LCE is a rapidly expanding research center with a strong international profile in net-zero transitions and sustainable energy systems. The center conducts research on integrated energy system design, renewable energy integration, PtX technologies, carbon management, sustainable biomass utilization, sector coupling, and CCUS integration.

SDU LCE is actively engaged in national and international research projects supported by the EU, national innovation programs, private companies, and other organizations.

Within SDU LCE, the research group focusing on renewable fuel production, process integration, techno-economic assessment, and energy system optimization is experiencing significant growth. The group combines detailed process modelling with system-level analysis to address the technological and economic challenges associated with industrial decarbonization.

For more information about SDU LCE, please visit www.sdu.dk/lifecycle. 

 

Qualifications

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a master’s degree in chemical engineering. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in process modelling, thermodynamic analysis, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of renewable energy conversion technologies. Experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage: 

•

• 
Modelling of Power-to-X technologies.

Thermodynamic modelling, mass and energy balances, process design, and heat integration.

Programming and numerical optimization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

• 
Understanding of renewable electricity integration, process flexibility, and sector coupling.

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an independent and curious research mindset, and an interest in interdisciplinary collaboration. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required.

 

Responsibilities

The successful PhD candidate will be expected to: 

• 
Develop detailed process simulation models of selected large-scale Power-to-X technologies and integrated production pathways.

• 
Perform thermodynamic analysis, mass and energy balances, and process integration assessments.

• 
Develop techno-economic models to estimate investment costs, operating costs, and levelized production costs of renewable fuels and chemicals.

• 
Apply optimization approaches to investigate process configurations, operating conditions, technology capacities, and economic performance.

• 
Evaluate the impacts of electricity prices, renewable energy availability, and feedstock supply on PtX system design and operation.

• 
Identify opportunities for improving energy efficiency, heat recovery, resource utilization, and process flexibility.

• 
Collaborate with academic and industrial partners involved in the research.

• 
Complete the required PhD courses (30 ECTS) and undertake a research stay abroad.

•

• 
Prepare and successfully defend a PhD thesis based on the research conducted.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Positions within Mobile Robotics at SDU Robotics
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within mobile robotics. We therefore invite applications for one or more postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

What we offer

• 
An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to the mobile robotics lab specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automated agriculture as well as related applications that require mobility in open terrain. We expect that the research activities involve both computer vision for scene understanding, tracking of relevant artefacts, as well as the integration and development of AI-based solutions for autonomous operation in scenarios within, e.g., field processing. The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in testing facilities at SDU as well as project partners and head the evaluation efforts in collaboration with a consortium of interdisciplinary project partners. 

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching and supervision responsibilities could also be part of employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

• 
Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics.

• 
Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

• 
Supporting the team in securing external funding.

• 
Participation in ongoing and future research projects.

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to mobile robots controlled with multimodal feedback. The candidates are hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Expert knowledge with ROS2 and relevant modules such as the Nav2

• 
Strong knowledge in multi-object tracking

• 
Experience in simulation of robotic systems

• 
Experience in design, development and integration of robotic systems

Furthermore, the successful candidates are expected to:

• 
Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

• 
Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

• 
Have the ability of working independently.

• 
Have a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Conduct independent research. 

Research environment

The candidates will be integrated in the unit SDU Robotics. We are a team of approximately 60 researchers and engineers based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in welfare, industrial automation, lab automation, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics. 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Associate Professor Leon Bodenhagen lebo@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

• 
Verified copies of official certificates/diplomas and transcripts of exams (MSc and PhD), both the original documents and in professional English translation.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position, may also be included. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

Employment terms

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

This postdoc position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in breast cancer epidemiology / clinical epidemiology
jobs.description:
The Department of Clinical Epidemiology at Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as postdoctoral research fellow in the field of Breast Cancer Epidemiology as per 15 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a two-year position is fully funded by the Health Insurance Denmark.The Department of Clinical Epidemiology is a research department at Aarhus University Hospital, within the Institute of Clinical Medicine at Aarhus University. Researchers in the department use advanced epidemiological methods to study the prognosis of patient populations. The department is engaged in a variety of activities regarding clinical epidemiological research, including cancer prognosis research. The department is involved in counselling health care professionals to improve the quality of health care and treatment. A large number of projects in the department are carried out in cooperation with Danish and international collaborators.About the research projectThe position entails research within clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship. The successful candidate will join a project focusing on studies related to adherence to breast cancer treatment; side effects and complications of breast cancer and its treatment; and how these may influence quality of life, long-term survivorship, and early and late breast cancer recurrence. The project investigates the association of pharmacological, genetic and socioeconomic factors and adherence to cancer treatment; employing advanced epidemiological methods including emulated target trials, group-based trajectory modelling, mediation analyses, and Bayesian modelling approaches to investigate adherence to cancer treatment and recurrence. The research fellow will join a vibrant and dynamic multinational and multidisciplinary project team (the Predictors of Breast Cancer Recurrence – ProBeCaRe – project team) with established successful long-term research collaboration. The successful applicant will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. They will work closely with colleagues, receiving supervision and guidance. Emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s interest in building bridges between clinical, epidemiological and biostatistical research.The main tasks will consist of:
• Research in clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship.
• Make applications as needed for access to Danish population-based and medical registries.
• Independently perform statistical analysis using programmes such as R, SAS, or equivalent.
• Collaborate within an active research group with national and international collaborators.
• Contribute to teaching at the Aarhus University and its collaborators, as necessary.
• Take part in grant writing and participate actively in research fundraising.
• Gain experience supervising students.
• Conduct independent research of high international quality, including publication.
• Write scientific articles and participate in international congresses.
• Perform other tasks within the Department of Clinical Epidemiology fields of interest. Please see our webpage at www.kea.au.dk.Your competencesYou have academic qualifications at PhD/DSc level preferably within one or more of the following areas: epidemiology, clinical epidemiology, cancer epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, and/or can document familiarity with epidemiological research at an international level. Research experience in cancer and pharmacologic research would be advantageous, but not essential. Research experience in epidemiologic methods, analysing and incorporating data from Danish registries, including data from the National Clinical Quality Cancer Databases (specifically data from the Danish Breast Cancer Group), the Health Services Register, and the National Patient Registry, would be useful, particularly data incorporating socioeconomic factors. Research experience in cancer survivorship, patient reported outcomes and national surveys would be a benefit as well. Evidence of the ability to secure competitive research grants would be advantageous. As a person, you are motivated, ambitious, take ownership and possess good communication and interpersonal skills. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English, with good knowledge of Danish.In order to be assessed as qualified for this position, you must meet these academic criteria.Shortlisting will be used.Principal supervisorDeirdre Cronin Fenton, PhD, ProfessorPhone: +45-87168209 / E-mail: dc@clin.au.dkDepartment of Clinical Epidemiology, Clinical Institute, Aarhus University, Olof Palmes Alle 43-45, 8200 Aarhus N.Questions about the positionIf you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Deirdre Cronin Fenton tel.: (+45) 8716 8209 or dc@clin.au.dk.Your place of work will be the Department of Clinical Epidemiology, Olof Palmes Alle 43-45, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.Terms of employment 
• Appointment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.
• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
• The yearly base salary for a fulltime postdoc is between DKK 493.394,35 and DKK 585.322,48 depending on the years of working experience after achieved MSc degree. The base salary includes a position related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplemement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.
• Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.
• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic StaffApplicationYour application must include the following:
• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Diploma
• Template for applicant - postdoc
• A list of publications
• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
• A maximum of five of the publications of greatest relevance to the job may be submitted (optional)
• Research plan can be uploaded (optional)
• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.International applicant?Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here. Aarhus University also has a Junior Researcher Association and offers career development support. You can read more about these resources here.The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

Experience working with Yocto

Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.
