Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions  Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences University of Copenhagen  The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.   Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.   Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems  The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.  The successful candidate will:   	
• Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes. 	
• Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications. 	
• Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets. 	
• Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems. 	
• Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks. 	
• Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making. 	
• Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.  	
• Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO. 	
• Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group. 	
• Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health. 	
• Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets. 	
• Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health. 	
• Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.   The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.  The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:    	
• research, including publication/academic dissemination 	
• research-based teaching  	
• sharing knowledge with society  	
• participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors    The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.   After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.  Required qualifications  To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:   	
• a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area  	
• research experience within the field of the position    The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.   The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.   Salary and employment conditions The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.  The position is permanent.   Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.   Questions  For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.  Application  The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:    	
• Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas) 	
• A complete list of publications  	
• Research plan (2-4 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment  	
• Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)   Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.  Application procedure After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee.  All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.   The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.   The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.   Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.  Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an Operations & Growth Manager to join our team and play an important role in the next stage of our growth. We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a growing consumer brand works from the inside and become involved across multiple areas of the business—from operations and retail to marketing, business development, data, systems, and growth.

The Role

As Operations & Growth Manager, you will help manage the day-to-day execution of the business while also working on projects that contribute directly to the company’s growth.

Your responsibilities will span five main areas:

·       Operations & Execution — approximately 30%

·       New Business Development — approximately 20%

·       Marketing & Brand Growth — approximately 20%

·       Business Intelligence & Analysis — approximately 20%

·       Processes, Systems & Automation — approximately 10%

The exact balance may evolve as the company grows. This is a role for someone who is comfortable switching between execution and strategy. 

What You'll Work On:

Operations & Retail Execution

You will help make sure the operational side runs accurately and efficiently.

This may include:

·       Managing and tracking purchase orders.

·       Monitoring inventory levels and availability.

·       Coordinating retailer orders.

·       Communicating with warehouses and logistics partners.

·       Following shipments and resolving delivery issues.

·       Managing Amazon inventory and operational requirements.

·       Supporting retailer compliance.

·       Coordinating invoices and documentation.

·       Communicating with customers, suppliers, retailers, warehouses, and external partners.

·       Identifying potential inventory shortages before they become problems.

·       Making sure deadlines and retailer requirements are met.

·       Improving operational accuracy.

·       Helping reduce preventable errors.

·       Creating better visibility into what is happening across the business.

 

Business Development & Retail Growth

You will also help identify and develop new commercial opportunities.

This may include:

·       Researching prospective retailers.

·       Identifying distributors and brokers.

·       Finding potential strategic partners.

·       Building lists of prospective accounts.

·       Conducting initial outreach.

·       Following up with prospective customers.

·       Preparing presentations and sales materials.

·       Coordinating product samples.

·       Preparing pricing and product information.

·        Supporting negotiations.

·       Helping onboard new accounts.

·       Researching new retail channels.

·       Identifying geographic expansion opportunities.

·       Helping grow relationships with existing accounts.

 

Marketing & Brand Growth

You will participate in initiatives designed to increase awareness, trial, engagement, and repeat purchase.

Projects may include:

·       Influencer partnerships.

·       Creator collaborations.

·       Social media initiatives.

·       Retail marketing programs.

·       Product sampling.

·       In-store activations.

·       Tastings.

·       Amazon marketing.

·       Brand partnerships.

·       Promotional campaigns.

·       LinkedIn and social content planning.

·       Retailer-specific marketing programs.

·       Coordinating marketing assets.

·       Tracking campaign results.

·       Identifying new ways to introduce consumers.

 

Business Intelligence & Analytics

As we grow, data will become increasingly important to how we make decisions. You will help organize information and transform it into useful insights.

This may include:

·       Building dashboards.

·       Tracking sales performance.

·       Analyzing inventory.

·       Reviewing Amazon performance.

·       Monitoring retail sell-through.

·       Comparing retailer performance.

·       Tracking marketing results.

·       Identifying patterns and trends.

·       Detecting potential risks.

·       Finding opportunities hidden in the data.

·       Preparing reports for company leadership.

·       Turning information into actionable recommendations.

Systems, Processes & Automation

We are building for the next stage of growth. That means improving not only what we do, but how we do it. You will help us create systems that make the business easier to operate and scale.

Projects may include:

·       Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

·       Documenting recurring processes.

·       Building internal templates.

·       Improving information organization.

·       Identifying repetitive manual work.

·       Finding opportunities for automation.

·       Implementing AI tools where useful.

·       Creating dashboards and internal tools.

·       Developing processes that can eventually be delegated.

·       Helping create more scalable operating systems.

 

Preferred Background 

·       A strong candidate may have experience or education in areas such as:

·       Business Administration

·       International Business

·       Operations

·       Supply Chain

·       Marketing

·       Business Development

·       Retail

·       Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)

·       E-commerce

·       Entrepreneurship

·       Analytics

 

Experience working with food, retail, Amazon, consumer products, logistics, distributors, brokers, or growing companies is a plus. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are highly valuable. Experience with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Notion, Canva, CRM platforms, dashboards, AI tools, or automation platforms is also a plus.

English is required. Spanish is highly valuable.

jobs.occupation: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

• 
A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

• 
Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

• 
An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

• 
Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

• 
Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

• 
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

• 
A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

Staff scheduling

jobs.occupation: Chief Commercial Officer
jobs.description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

Hos Rays Chicken tager vi fried chicken seriøst. Vi laver ekstra sprød, kærnemælksmarineret fried chicken krydret med vores egen hemmelige krydderiblanding, som vi serverer for et livligt og fyldt Gamma Bar i København Nordvest.

Vi lægger i øjeblikket fundamentet for spændende fremtidig vækst og søger en dedikeret kok, der har lyst til at være en central del af den rejse.

Vi søger en erfaren og pålidelig køkkenprofil, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift, opretholde en høj madkvalitet og bevare overblikket under travle perioder.

På de mere rolige vagter i starten af ugen har du fuld frihed og selvstændighed til at preppe og køre køkkenet alene. På de travle aftener styrer du servicen og leder køkkenets medhjælpere og opvaskere.

Vigtigste ansvarsområder:

• 
Mise en place og service: Daglig klargøring, madlavning, fritering, anretning og sikring af en høj standard.

Selvstændige vagter: Ansvar for at drive køkkendriften solo på ugens tidlige vagter.

Hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed: Holde orden i køkkenets systemer og strengt overholde danske standarder for fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

• 
Digitale bestillinger: Effektiv betjening af takeaway- og online bestillingsplatforme.

• 
Menuudvikling (Bonus): Vi ønsker aktivt at videreudvikle vores menu. Selvom det ikke er et krav, er interesse for opskriftsudvikling og kreative input et stort plus!

Hvem er du?

• 
Erfaring: Minimum 3 års professionel køkkenerfaring.

• 
Selvstændighed: Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner.

• 
Tempo og overblik: Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder.

• 
Fysisk form: Kan trives med at arbejde fulde vagter på benene.

• 
Tilgængelighed: Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter.

• 
Kommunikation: Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus).

• 
Passion: En ægte kærlighed til fried chicken og comfort food i høj kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Timeløn mellem 165 og 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring.

• 
En afslappet, lokalt forankret stemning på Gamma Bar i det kreative Nordvest.

• 
Mulighed for at præge de daglige arbejdsgange og få indflydelse på fremtidige menu-tiltag i takt med, at konceptet udvider sig.

Sådan ansøger du

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning om, hvorfor du er det rette match for Rays Chicken til:

• 
E-mail: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Emnefelt: Rays Chefs

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!------------------

English Version

Location: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, Copenhagen

Employment Type: Part-time / Full-time (Evenings & Weekends)

Pay: 165 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as possible

About Rays Chicken

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Food Prep & Service: Daily mise en place, cooking, frying, plating, and ensuring high food quality.

• 
Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

• 
Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

• 
Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

• 
Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

• 
Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

• 
Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

• 
Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

• 
Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

• 
Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

• 
Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

• 
Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

• 
Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

• 
Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

• 
A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

• 
Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

• 
Email: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Subject line: Rays Chefs

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you!

DANSK VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Trives du i en tempofyldt gæstfrihedskultur, elsker du surdejspizza på højeste niveau, og har du den operationelle rygrad til at drive et hurtigtvoksende restaurantbrand?

Siden åbningen på Blågårds Plads har Diamond Slice redefineret New York-style pizza i København. Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Nøgleområder og ansvarsopgaver

• 
Forretningsdrift & systemer:

• 
Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

• 
Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

• 
Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

• 
Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

• 
FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

• 
Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

• 
Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

• 
Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

• 
Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

• 
Catering, festivaler & vækst:

• 
Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

• 
Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

• 
Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

• 
Økonomistyring & rapportering:

• 
Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

• 
Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

• 
Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

• 
Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

• 
Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

• 
Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

• 
Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

• 
En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

• 
Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

• 
En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

• 
En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

• 
Business Operations & Systems:

• 
Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

• 
Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

• 
Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

• 
Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

• 
FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

• 
Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

• 
Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

• 
Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

• 
Catering, Festivals & Growth:

• 
Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

• 
Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

• 
Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

• 
Financial Control & Reporting:

• 
Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

• 
Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

• 
Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

• 
Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

• 
Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

• 
Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

• 
A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

• 
Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

• 
A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

• 
Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

• 
A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

3.       Er pligtopfyldende og letforståelig på engelsk eller dansk

Vi tilbyder:

2.       Arbejdstid i tidsrummet 07:00-15:00

Lyder stillingen interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail gm@vikinggulvservice.dk

Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

ENGLISH:

Viking Gulvservice is a well-established company located in Ballerup. Over the years, we have provided professional painting services to a wide range of customers. In addition to flooring services, we also offer painting and carpentry services.

We are currently looking for 1–2 experienced colleagues to join our carpentry team and help us handle our growing portfolio of projects.

If you have experience as a carpenter and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a positive and friendly atmosphere.

At Viking Gulvservice, you will work on a variety of carpentry tasks, including building floor structures, installing plasterboard/drywall, constructing light timber structures, and other related carpentry work.

You will normally work together with a colleague, so there will usually be two of you assigned to each project. For smaller jobs, however, you should be comfortable working independently.

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions?

You are very welcome to contact us by email at gm@vikinggulvservice.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
jobs.description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offerThe successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expectWe expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

• 
Strong research and publication record;

• 
Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

• 
Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

• 
Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environmentSDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

• 
Research plan.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) .
